title: Click To Move
description: Click to Move is a challenge mod that completely removes the standard controls
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b88b3d7e200cffa9f914dc1d47294e81d97531aa.png)

**Click to Move** -  is a **_challenge mod_** that completely removes the standard controls, replacing nearly all functions with mouse controls.

The inventory mechanics have also been completely revamped.
Now the inventory appears as a series of rings, with 9 slots initially available, plus slots for your off-hand and armor. However, if you place a chest in the appropriate slot, you’ll gain 3 additional rings that you can switch between to cycle through items!

How do you get a workbench if there’s no crafting window in the inventory? Just chop down any tree and use any type of log to hit another log, and you’ll get a workbench

![new inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7753f1cb33648e3876b7224b2120199461e8203b_0.webp)

# Controls:
- **Movement - Hold down the right mouse button (you will move in the direction you are facing)**
- **Jump - Double-click the left mouse button**
- **Sneak - Double-click the right mouse button**
- **Open inventory - Middle mouse button**
